title: Find and delete empty files or directories
summary: Locate empty files or folders and delete them immediately. This action cannot be undone.

steps.explain: Find empty files (-type f) or directories (-type d) and delete them. Use -print to see what is being deleted.

placeholders.name: TYPE
placeholders.description: Type of item to find: 'f' for files, 'd' for directories

warnings: This permanently deletes files and folders. There is no undo.
Double-check the directory path before running.

rollback.explain: There is no built-in undo for find -delete. Restore from backup if necessary.
